verdict.rationale: Antigravity's docs describe natural-language-driven agents that read files, run commands and edit code (docs-9, docs-40). They operate across the editor, terminal and browser (docs-7), draw codebase context from one or more folders (docs-17), plan work before executing (docs-24), and present code diffs for review (docs-30, docs-33). That is clearly the core of this story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one plain-language request produces coordinated edits across multiple files (this is only implied by project context and diff review), a documented bug-fix workflow, and independent hands-on confirmation of multi-file feature or fix quality (the one favorable community comment says only that the CLI 'works fine').
